title: IAM users and groups

kcs.statement: IAM is a global, no-cost AWS service that controls who can sign in to an account (authentication) and what they are allowed to do (authorization).
An IAM user is a long-term identity for one person or application with its own credentials, and a newly created IAM user has no permissions until some are granted.
An IAM group is a collection of IAM users that share the permissions attached to the group; a user can belong to several groups, but groups cannot contain other groups.
